description:
-Wonderful 3 Bedroom Semi Detached Home With Attached Garage

-Large Private South Facing Rear Garden

-Excellent Scope For Enlargement

-Private Off Street Parking For Two Cars

-Highly Sought-After Cul-De-Sac Location Close To Every Amenity

Premium Collection are delighted to bring to the market this wonderful 3 bedroom semi-detached home in the highly sought-after location of Eden Park Road in the heart of Goatstown. Presented in good condition throughout, this home offers comfortable accommodation with generously sized rooms together with excellent potential for enlargement both to the side and to the rear of the property. 

The large mature and private south facing rear garden makes this home ideal for families, downsizers and/or purchasers seeking a property with genuine potential to create something very special. Providing ample off street parking within a mature garden to the front including an attached garage, this home also displays excellent curb appeal in a quiet residential setting.

Upon entering through the glass enclosed porch into a light, bright and spacious hallway, the main living room to the left offers a large front window filling the space with natural light in the mornings and a working feature fireplace. Further down the hallway is a separate spacious dining room which comprises patio door access to the rear garden and large pation and which provides excellent scope for opening out both into the kitchen or the livingroom. The west facing kitchen/breakfast room also accesses the rear garden and offers ample storage and work space and comprises oak country style kitchen cabinets and wood floors. 

Upstairs provides for three generously proportioned bedrooms, all with built in wardrobes, from a central landing and a good sized light and bright main bathroom with separate shower and floor to ceiling tile throughout. 

The rear garden is a wonderful feature with a large patio area and extensive 30 metre long lawn with a southerly aspect and includes a large storage shed and outdoor w/c. Exceptionally generous by modern standards, it provides excellent scope for a future home extensionj without affecting the marvelous outdoor space. To the front there is ample parking for multiple cars in a large private brick paved driveway in addition to the attached garage which provides a huge amount of extra storage and scope for enlargement.

Ideally located in the heart of Goatstown, this property benefits from an excellent selection of schools, UCD, local shops, cafes and recreational amenities while Dundrum, Stillorgan and Dublin City are all readily accessable being well served by many nearby transport links including the LUAS being only 750m away.

Viewing Is Highly Recommended.
